name: FlexASIO
note: Pin of the FlexASIO installer that scripts/install-flexasio.js downloads (FlexASIO is MIT-licensed; its installer is an Inno Setup program named FlexASIO-<version>.exe on https://github.com/dechamps/FlexASIO/releases). Nothing is downloaded or run until sha256 is filled in: put the SHA-256 of the installer .exe you checked on the release page (the script refuses an installer it cannot verify). args are Inno Setup's silent switches.
